Choosing rows on the first five years and starting flat on the last five selected 3 rows: 2 stayed positive over 363 test trades at +0.098R per trade, a retrospective dependent sample at a uniform cost of 0.05 normal day with futures roll risk and D1 path uncertainty, not a prospective probability. EURUSD and USDJPY closes are the next session's open, because Yahoo's daily currency bar carries the day's open as its close.
